title: DriveMind: Mind-Evolving Belief Tracking for Closed-Loop Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2610.32069v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can perceive a traffic scene, reason about it, and propose a driving action within a single model. However, existing MLLM-based drivers reason from scratch at each frame and commit to a single explanation, discarding earlier hypotheses about the scene. When the scene is ambiguous, the agent locks in on the wrong interpretation and acts on it before evidence accumulates. In this paper, we propose DriveMind, an MLLM-based driving framework that keeps several hypotheses about the scene alive at the same time and updates their weights as new frames arrive. Inspired by particle filtering, DriveMind propagates each hypothesis through a VLM, scores it against the current observation, and resamples to maintain diversity. translated_title: DriveMind：面向闭环自动驾驶的思维演化信念跟踪
translated_abstract: 近年来，多模态大语言模型（MLLM）能够在单一模型内完成对交通场景的感知、推理并提出驾驶动作。然而，现有的基于MLLM的驾驶系统在每一帧都从零开始推理，并且只坚持一种解释，丢弃了此前对场景的其他假设。当场景存在歧义时，智能体会在证据尚未积累完整之前就锁定错误的解读并据此行动。本文提出DriveMind，一个基于MLLM的驾驶框架，它能够同时保留多个关于场景的假设，并随着新帧的到来动态更新这些假设的权重。受粒子滤波思想启发，DriveMind通过视觉语言模型（VLM）传播每个假设，依据当前观测对其进行评分，并通过重采样保持假设的多样性。在Bench2Drive基准上，在相同的驾驶流程中加入信念跟踪后，驾驶分数（DS）从68.50提升至81.37，成功率（SR）从41.36%提升至54.09%。
tldr: DriveMind借鉴粒子滤波思想，让基于MLLM的驾驶智能体同时维护多个场景假设并随新观测动态更新权重与重采样，从而显著提升闭环自动驾驶性能。
en_tdlr: DriveMind maintains multiple scene hypotheses with particle-filter-inspired weight updates and resampling for MLLM-based driving agents, significantly improving closed-loop autonomous driving performance.
